And, by this chain, from Hammad, from Rabie, from Al Fuzayl who said, 
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying:

‘From the matters is a matter suspended in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. He<sup>azwj</sup> Brings forward from these whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to, and Delays from these whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to’.
